prompt:
Create one native 4K 16:9 clean 2D animated-film location design, an EMPTY modest ancient Chinese county office entrance. A SINGLE frontal view from due south, slightly elevated, looking due north. Image left is west, image right is east. Use a long lens with nearly parallel horizontal facade lines; not a diagonal corner view. Show the complete low tiled roof with clear margin above it, full gateway, ground and full notice wall.
Composition left to right: blank west boundary wall with clear standing space in front; a small low wooden gateway at centre-left; a separate short notice wall on the right/east. The notice wall runs LEFT-TO-RIGHT, PARALLEL to the gateway facade and to the picture plane. Its broad SOUTH face looks DIRECTLY toward the viewer. Its top edge is HORIZONTAL across the picture, never a long diagonal running toward the camera. The left end of this wall has one inset old wood notice board containing exactly one blank cream paper. The remainder of the south-facing wall is plain pale grey plaster for future posting. The wall stands east of the gate, without extending into or across the gateway passage.
Two heavy plain wooden door leaves open inward. The threshold is recessed beneath the eaves, passage at least two adults wide. A broad empty stone-paved forecourt connects the west standing area, open gate and notice wall. Low ordinary grey plaster, muted brown timber, small simple roof. No people, animals, text, inscription, stone lions, palace, city tower, temple icon, objects blocking the passage, diagrams or insets.
Soft diffuse daylight, warm grey light, cool grey shadow, desaturated natural colours. Fine consistent outlines, broad flat colours and two simple shadow levels, very low material texture; no realistic grain, paper texture, heavy noise or photographic rendering.
